cpu_model: AMD EPYC-Rome Processor (KVM guest), 16 vCPU, 30 GiB RAM, shared loaded host
prover: not built, not run; no key, entry or proof was made

commits.patched_binary_built_from: verifier sources of 1822a3d3 (unchanged through the reviewed head and the fix commits)

toolchain.whole_verifier_sanitized_attempt: g++ -O1 -g -fno-ipa-modref -D_GLIBCXX_ASSERTIONS -fno-omit-frame-pointer -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -std=c++17 -pthread -I. -I../../blocks -I../../prover -DBLK_FIELD=2 -DBLK_COUNT_HASH_CALLS=1 -DSERVING_BUILD=1 -DDIGEST_WORDS=8 -DVF_SOURCE_DIGEST=<source digest> cp_verify.cpp: did not finish in 120 s (runs/compiled/build-cp_verify-sanitized-once.json); no sanitized cp_verify exists in this experiment

seeds.what: parameter_walk.py, smoke run of amendment 3 and coverage run of amendment 4
seeds.seed: the script's default --seed 1; its generator is random.Random('pinned_no_proof_of_work 1')

seeds.what: planning cases, kits, existing rows, rotary files
seeds.seed: none: no random number is drawn; kits and files are made by fixed rules (kits.py, rotary_files.py)

fix_lane_environment_amendment_4.what: runs added after review under PREREG Amendment 4: runs-4/existing (T8 rounds 2 to 5), runs-4/rotary, runs-4/walk, runs-4/suite-rows-by-hand
fix_lane_environment_amendment_4.hardware: cpu-epyc-rome-kvm-16, the same shared loaded host (16 vCPU, 30 GiB RAM)
fix_lane_environment_amendment_4.binaries: rebuilt by verifier/build.sh in a private mktemp folder, base from a git archive of 2583aca9, patched from the reviewed head; their SHA-256 equal binaries.base.sha256 and binaries.patched.sha256 above
fix_lane_environment_amendment_4.limits: rotary and walk calls: prlimit --as=4294967296 and timeout 120; T8 rows: the committed run_existing.py's own 4 GiB address-space limit and 600 s
fix_lane_environment_amendment_4.concurrency: the T8 completion run held cores 4-5 through the heavy-job gate; the rotary calls, the walk run and the two compiled suite rows ran on the same two cores while it was running; base and patched T8 calls were never side by side

limits: each cp_verify call: 4 GiB address-space limit (RLIMIT_AS), 110 s wall; compiled sanitized programs run without the address-space limit

commands.planning: python3 -B experiments/20261114-195-dq-ne-d-admission/run_planning.py <REPO> <base cp_verify> <patched cp_verify> <new work folder> <output folder> <round 1..5>; then: run_planning.py summarise <output folder>
commands.existing: python3 -B experiments/20261114-195-dq-ne-d-admission/run_existing.py <REPO> <base|patched> <cp_verify> <work folder> <output folder> 1 <group A..E>; then: run_existing.py compare <output folder>

placeholders: <REPO> the checkout, <WORK> and <PLANNING> the lane's work folders outside the checkout, <WORKSPACE> their parent, <TMP> a mktemp folder, <work> a run's own work folder, <cp_verify> the binary
